# A flat cloud of three faceted puffs, 2.4 m wide, cream (unlit). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Cloud --base-color 1.000 0.906 0.839 --no-slot --emission 1.000 0.906 0.839
add mesh ico-sphere --name A --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location -0.7 0 0
add mesh ico-sphere --name B --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.65 --location 0.05 0 0.18
add mesh ico-sphere --name C --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.45 --location 0.75 0 -0.02
select A B C
scale 1.2 0.3 0.7
apply --scale
material assign Cloud
shade flat
export cloud.glb
